name: Article from Ticket
description: Brief → outline → draft → SEO → browser preview → publish-ready report.
kickoff:
Start the "Article from Ticket" loop.
Goal: publish-ready article matching the ticket brief
Max iterations: 5
Exit when: draft passes SEO and browser preview checks.
Orientation: read the linked ticket brief for audience, angle, keywords, and CTA.
Step 1: Ingest the content brief and list gaps to confirm.

loop_contract.name: Article from Ticket
loop_contract.exit_when: draft passes SEO and browser preview
guardrails: Do not modify the check command or exit criteria to force success
Do not skip, disable, or bypass checks to pass the exit condition
If stuck after several iterations, stop and report blockers instead of gaming metrics
loop_contract.pacing_notes: Self-pace this loop. After each iteration, run the check command, read the output, and only continue if the exit condition is not met. Stop when the exit condition passes or max iterations is reached. Give a short status update each pass.
loop_contract.step_1: Read ticket brief: audience, angle, keywords, CTA, brand voice, deadline. List gaps to confirm.

steps.name: Ingest content brief
steps.instruction: Read ticket brief: audience, angle, keywords, CTA, brand voice, deadline. List gaps to confirm.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof
steps.validation_prompt: Step 'Ingest content brief' completed with evidence.

steps.name: Outline article
steps.instruction: Produce H2/H3 outline with keyword map and internal link targets. Use article-writing and writing-plans.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof

steps.name: Draft body
steps.instruction: Write the draft following the outline. Use content-engine and doc-coauthoring patterns.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof

steps.name: SEO and metadata pass
steps.instruction: Run seo skill: title, meta, headings, snippet. Fix readability issues.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof
steps.validation_prompt: Step 'SEO and metadata pass' completed with evidence.

steps.name: Preview in browser
steps.instruction: Render preview (local CMS, staging, or markdown preview). Check formatting, links, CTA.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof
steps.validation_prompt: Step 'Preview in browser' completed with evidence.

steps.name: Evaluate publish-ready
steps.instruction: Draft matches brief, SEO pass done, preview checked.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof

steps.name: Report
steps.instruction: Publish checklist and draft location for human approval.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof
